DESCRIPTION: Remediation chains can never escalate beyond step 0. `record_round` explicitly suppresses systemic diagnoses via `if pathology_key not in self._remediation_state`, preventing the natural re-triggering of a persistent pathology. When a step 0 fix fails, `_verify_remediation_outcomes` emits a `"remediation_outcome"` diagnosis to trigger escalation, but `apply_diagnosis` explicitly ignores it (`if diagnosis.detector == "remediation_outcome": return None`). With natural diagnoses suppressed and outcome diagnoses ignored, the chain stalls permanently, never applying step 1+.
PROPOSED_FIX: Modify `apply_diagnosis` to actively process `"remediation_outcome"` diagnoses for escalation (bypassing damping), while moving the suppression of natural diagnoses into `apply_diagnosis` to cover all pathology types correctly.

FINDING_ID: IM_F011
SEVERITY: 0.88
FLAW_CLASS: 5
ABSTRACTION_INDEX: 0.65
DESCRIPTION: `false_positive_rate` drastically under-reports the true FP rate because `total_detections` counts every single diagnosis emitted (which, for persistent unresolved pathologies, occurs every round), while `natural_resolutions` correctly counts only one resolution per unique pathology instance. This inflates the denominator, preventing the false positive rate from ever exceeding 50% and permanently disabling Self-check 2 (sensitivity reduction).
PROPOSED_FIX: Filter `all_detections` to include only the initial detection of each pathology instance by checking `occurrence == 1` or `persistence == 1`.
